notes: Client is Prachi herself. Round 1 (hand-built, 2026-10-04, deleted) failed: she called it very buggy, AI-generated-looking, and said nothing in it interestingly reflected her personality. Round 2 (this Stem Cell run): a personality web of her interests — an interactive constellation graph where nodes are interests and edges encode real connections (fish->code via LED fish repo, geology->code via gneissvision, space->code via petrova-log). Structurally distinct from round 1 per her 30% retry rule.
